title: Ghosted's Better Crafting
description: "Just More Recipes" New recipes for ones that don't have one.
body:
# Better Crafting
Better Crafting is a simple mod that focuses on new crafting recipes for items that don't have one. Don't worry, each recipe was carefully planed and provides a ballance between Overpowered and challanging.
